result.title: LLM-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Learning with Business Semantics for Financial Fraud Detection
result.summary: Financial fraud detection increasingly relies on heterogeneous transaction graphs, in which entities such as cards and merchants play distinct business roles and the risk meaning of an attribute depends on the entity's role: a high transaction volume may be routine for a merchant but unusual for a card. Heterogeneous graph neural networks preserve typed entities and relations but typically treat these attributes as role-agnostic inputs and leave their business meaning implicit. Meanwhile, most existing methods integrating large language models (LLMs) with graphs focus on homogeneous graphs or heterogeneous graphs with naturally available textual attributes, leaving their use on transaction graphs with structured attributes underexplored. To address this issue, we propose SemHGT, an LLM-enhanced framework that interprets structured attributes according to entity roles and makes the business semantics explicit in three stages: (1) role-aware prompts elicit risk-related business descriptions from node attributes, and a text encoder maps them to semantic vectors that enrich node representations; (2) semantic similarity guides multi-round sampling of target-specific path instances under transaction-to-transaction schemas; (3) schema-level tokens that combine local path evidence with global neighbor summaries are processed together with the target transaction by a unified transformer. Across three benchmark datasets, SemHGT leads the evaluated baselines on most dataset--metric comparisons. Further analyses provide additional evidence for the effectiveness of SemHGT's design and clarify how its semantic modeling and evidence selection contribute to fraud detection. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SemHGT-528A/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SemHGT，用角色感知 prompt 让 LLM 为异质交易图中的结构化属性生成业务语义描述并编码为节点表示，再由语义相似度引导多轮路径实例采样，最后把局部路径证据与全局邻居摘要组成 schema 级 token 交由统一 transformer 判别欺诈。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义相似度引导的证据采样 + 局部路径与全局摘要在统一 transformer 中融合」或可迁移到 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选与状态压缩；但论文本身不做视觉或多模态推理，仅为方法线索，需核查。
